summary: Bandwidth Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a proposed private offering of $275 million aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2032, with an over-allotment option for an additional $41.25 million. The notes are senior, unsecured, convertible into cash, stock, or a combination at Bandwidth's election, with terms to be set at pricing. Proceeds will partly fund capped call transactions and up to $10 million for concurrent share repurchases. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
